replace.with: Apart from the 30-Day Go-Live Commitment, these durations are planning estimates drawn from completed projects. Under the 30-Day Go-Live Commitment, Kestravane guarantees go-live within 30 calendar days of the kickoff call for Operations rollouts of up to 200 vehicles, provided the customer supplies the vehicle list within 5 business days of the kickoff call and releases vehicles on the agreed installation days. If Kestravane misses the date for reasons within its control, the onboarding fee is refunded in full. The commitment is part of the standard Operations order form, and account teams may state it to customers and prospects. It does not apply to larger Operations fleets or to Enterprise rollouts.

facts_changed.statement: An Operations rollout of up to 200 vehicles goes live within 30 calendar days of kickoff and is covered by the 30-Day Go-Live Commitment.

Kestravane guarantees go-live within 30 calendar days of the kickoff call for Operations rollouts of up to 200 vehicles, provided the customer supplies the vehicle list within 5 business days of kickoff and releases vehicles on the agreed installation days; if Kestravane misses the date for reasons within its control the onboarding fee is refunded in full; the commitment is in the standard Operations order form and account teams may state it; it does not apply to larger Operations fleets or Enterprise.

note: The implementation guide gains an explicit, scoped 30-day go-live guarantee for Operations rollouts of up to 200 vehicles, with conditions and a remedy; the estimate-only paragraph is replaced.
